description: List registered Python skills (`action='list'`) or execute a named skill (`action='execute'`) with arguments in isolation, returning its deterministic return value. Use to run already-verified skills; call `oxyo_skill_register` first to create a new skill.

action.description: Choose 'list' to browse available skills or 'execute' to run `name` with `args`.

args.description: Positional JSON arguments passed to the skill entrypoint when action='execute'.

name.description: Registered skill name to execute (required when action='execute').

name: oxyo_skill_invoke
